`verify.js` is bundled from DefnoJae/Seanime-Verify `src/verify.js` (version 0.1.0). It detects supported verification failures and returns clear errors. It is not an automatic CAPTCHA solver or a shared live session.

Refresh the bundled source at development time with `node build.cjs ../Seanime-Verify`. Normal `node build.cjs` uses the checked-in copy. Installed providers do not download or evaluate helper code.
